prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1254; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give my statement without my name on it, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving on a main road in Pasadena, Texas, heading toward a shopping center. I was turning left into the parking lot.
Q: What was the traffic like at the time?
A: It was fairly steady. There was a car coming from the other direction, and I thought I had enough space to make the turn.
Q: What happened next?
A: I started my turn, and then a vehicle coming through the intersection hit the rear passenger side of my car. I didn't see it coming until it was too late.
Q: Did you notice whether your signal was on?
A: Yes, I had my left turn signal on for a good stretch before I reached the intersection.
Q: Were you able to get out of the vehicle after the impact?
A: I got out, but my shoulder was hurting right away. It was my right shoulder, and I had trouble lifting my arm.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They did X-rays and told me I had a strained shoulder and I was given a sling.
Q: Are you still having symptoms?
A: Yes, I still have pain when I reach overhead or try to lift anything heavy. I've been doing physical therapy.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I believe I was turning safely and the other driver should have been watching for traffic. I'm hoping this gets resolved quickly.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
